data.component: Cscape HMI Dynamic Hexagonal Binning Heatmap & Density Scatter SCADA Canvas

tests.details: Verified 'HexbinCanvasSync' and 'HexbinHeatmapScadaSync' POUs with SecurityGuard & STParser across Horner registers %R1860..%R1867 and %M434..%M435.
Rejected 6/6 forbidden ladder logic constructs with LadderForbiddenError.
Verified regular hex tessellation (R=22.0 px, apothem r_in=19.05 px), pointy/flat axial quantization, and 6-vertex polygon geometry.
Verified canonical distribution: 500 points across 48 bins, Max=42, Mean=10.4, Peak at (45.0, 28.0) scaled (450, 280).
Verified Linear vs Logarithmic density normalization curves and Cool-to-Warm, Magma, and Plasma multi-stop perceptual gradient synthesis.
Verified %M435 assertion when MaxHexBinDensity > 35, de-assertion when density <= 35, and nominal recovery.
Verified 0xF101 (Tessellation Singularity), 0xF102 (Empty Dataset), 0xF103 (Density Overflow), and 0xF104 (SVG Render Fault) with %R1867 latching and nominal reset.
Verified standalone W3C SVG 1.1 with WCAG 2.1 AAA contrast (> 18:1), 48 <polygon> hex bins, reticle crosshairs, HUD scorecard, and colorbar legend -> artifacts\HMI\hexbin_canvas_sample.svg.
Verified %R1860..%R1867 (48, 500, 42, 104, 450, 280, 22, 0) and %M434..%M435 (True, True) with PrivilegeMode.SYSTEM and discrete ILogicUnit scan cycle execution.
